recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, close-up portrait of a head completely wrapped in white gauze bandages, leaving only a single, intense blue eye visible through a jagged tear. The composition is centered and minimalist, focusing on the contrast between the soft texture of the knit fabric and the sharp, black graphic typography overlaid on the bandages.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, textured bandages and the sharp, geometric letterforms.
The singular blue eye acting as the only point of color and emotional intensity.
High-key lighting that bleeds the white bandages into the white background.
Diagonal tension created by the tear in the bandages across the face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head occupies the majority of the frame, tightly cropped and centered.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The single blue eye in the upper right quadrant serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the intense blue iris, follows the diagonal line of the bandage tear down to the central black text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space at the edges, blending seamlessly with the subject's highlights.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (bandages and background) providing a clean, clinical, and bright base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (typography) for maximum legibility and graphic punch.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue (iris) as the sole saturated hue to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value (brightness) throughout, with low saturation except for the iris.
paletteRestrictions: Monochromatic white/grey/black with one singular color accent.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast serif with sharp, needle-like terminals.
Secondary text uses a slanted, angular, stencil-like industrial aesthetic.
Horizontal bars in the serif font are extremely thin compared to vertical strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters feature extended, sharp apexes that resemble thorns or spikes.
The 'W' is constructed from two overlapping 'V' shapes with sharp points.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a sharp, aggressive techno-logo and a sophisticated but dangerous-looking high-contrast serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high contrast and sharp serifs required for the main text.
Matches the aggressive, industrial feel of the secondary logo text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio photograph of a person's head completely wrapped in white knit gauze bandages. A jagged tear in the bandages reveals one intense blue eye. The lighting is bright and soft, causing the edges of the head to blend into a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply sharp, black, high-contrast serif typography in all caps across the center of the image. Ensure the terminals are pointed and the vertical strokes are thick.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the only saturated color element?
Does the bandage texture look like a knit fabric?
Are the letterforms sharp and aggressive?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue eye color
Amount of shadow in the bandage folds
mustRedesign: Exact letterform shapes of the secondary text
Specific facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame.
Verify the bandage texture is visible even in bright areas.
Check that the black text has no transparency.
Confirm the eye is centered vertically within its tear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-key textural photography with aggressive, high-contrast display typography to create a sense of tension and focus.
